messages.author: 4f1c75b4bf429538
messages.subject: Sanitized file names for markdown
parts:
I am hitting a problem with knitr_1.4.1, where the figure output path is "sanitized" to remove non alpha numeric characters, except underscore. 

The code in utils.R suggests that this is because of Latex:



#'   When there are special characters (not alphanumeric or \samp{-} or


#'   \samp{_}) in the path, they will be automatically replaced with \samp{_}.


#'   For example, \file{a b/c.d-} will be sanitized to \file{a_b/c_d-}. This


#'   makes the filenames safe to LaTeX.


fig_path = function(suffix = '', options = opts_current$get()) {



  path = valid_path(options$fig.path, options$label)



  (if (out_format(c('latex', 'sweave', 'listings', 'markdown'))) sanitize_fn else



    str_c)(path, suffix)



}



However is this not needed for markdown output and is sending my figures to another directory from the html output. 


If it possible to turn off this feature anywhere?


Thanks,




Stew

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Sanitized file names for markdown
parts:
Well, it was also due to a bug in RStudio when converting Markdown to
HTML; special characters in the image URL's will make RStudio fail to
base64 encode the images. You are recommended to use _, -, and
alphanumeric characters, and I'll send a bug report to RStudio. Once
it is fixed in RStudio, I'll remove this constraint. Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
--
